insights.headline: Gold holds near $4,100 on Dhanteras after a two-week high; US payrolls due at 7 PM IST
insights.summary: Spot gold held near $4,100 after touching a two-week high above $4,140 on a softer dollar and lower Treasury yields following the US midterm elections, while MCX gold rose about Rs 6,500 per 10 g in two days. Silver faces a split outlook: Metals Focus sees a 2027 surplus as solar-panel makers use less silver, leaving the price case to investor buying. Dhanteras shoppers are choosing lighter jewellery and old-gold exchange, with jewellers expecting flat volumes but 20–30% higher sales by value. The US October payrolls report at 7 PM IST is the next test for December rate-hike bets.
points: Spot gold touched $4,148 intraday and held near $4,087, up 0.6%, as a tech-led Wall Street selloff cut December hike bets.
MCX gold added about Rs 6,500 per 10 g in two days and Delhi gold climbed Rs 2,200 to Rs 1.48 lakh per 10 g.
Metals Focus sees silver swinging to a 37.3-million-ounce surplus in 2027; only investor inflows can absorb it.
Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 gold target to $4,150 from $4,650 after the Fed's hawkish turn.
US October payrolls, due at 7 PM IST with a consensus of 65,000 jobs, could shift December hike bets.

brief.headline: Gold stays near $4,100 as yields ease into Dhanteras
brief.summary: MCX gold rose about Rs 6,500 per 10 g in two days as a softer dollar lifted spot gold near $4,087 into Dhanteras.

bullets.text: Reuters says a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields after the US midterm results lifted bullion, with December rate-hike bets easing.
Dhanteras demand picked up in Delhi as prices eased, and jewellers expect strong sales with shoppers choosing lighter pieces.
Watch the US October payrolls report at 7 PM IST, which could shift December rate-hike bets and the dollar.

trending.title: Gold holds near $4,100 into Dhanteras; payrolls tonight
trending.summary: Bullion held a more than two-week high into Dhanteras as a softer dollar and lower yields lifted prices after the US midterms; Friday's payrolls report at 7 PM IST is the next test.

trending.title: Goldman cuts targets as a hawkish Fed caps the rally
trending.summary: Goldman Sachs lowered its end-2026 and end-2027 gold targets after the Fed's hawkish turn, and Fed officials keep the door open to more rate rises, capping bullion's rebound.

trending.title: Silver's 2027 surplus puts the price case on investors
trending.summary: Metals Focus sees silver swinging to a 37.3-million-ounce surplus in 2027 as solar makers use less metal per panel, so the price case rests on fund buying; silver should keep lagging gold.

trending.title: Dhanteras buying shifts lighter as value outruns volume
trending.summary: Shoppers are choosing lighter jewellery, small coins and old-gold exchange at high prices; jewellers expect flat volumes but 20-30% higher sales by value, with enquiries up sharply since prices eased.

items.title: Gold holds gains, silver slips as Wall Street plunges, Fed hike bets ease - Kitco PM Report
items.summary: Spot gold held near $4,087 an ounce in late US trading on Thursday, up 0.6%, after touching $4,148 intraday, as a tech-led Wall Street selloff pushed Treasury yields lower and cut December Fed hike bets to about 66-69% from 83%. Spot silver slipped 0.8% to about $51.78 as industrial-demand worries weighed. Attention turns to Friday's October US payrolls report.

items.title: Gold hits a two-week high as dollar, Treasury yields ease after US midterm elections
items.summary: Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce on Thursday, its highest since October 22, as a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields followed the Democrats' midterm sweep, Reuters reports. December futures rose 1.8% to $4,144.20 and spot silver rose 1.7% to $53.12. Traders await Friday's payrolls, pricing an 82% chance of a December Fed rise, per CME FedWatch.

items.title: Gold prices jump Rs 6,500/10 gram in 2 days; silver soars Rs 11,200/kg as soft dollar, fall oil boost mood
items.summary: MCX gold added about Rs 6,400 per 10 g and silver about Rs 11,231 per kg over two sessions, with December gold futures at Rs 1,45,909 per 10 g, the Economic Times reports. Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce, its highest since October 22, and spot silver 1.7% to $53.12, as a weaker dollar, falling US yields and crude oil down about 10% followed the Democrats' midterm sweep.

items.title: Gold rises to near $4,100 ahead of US NFP data
items.summary: Gold rose to a more than two-week high near $4,085 in early Asian trading on Friday, helped by a weaker dollar and lower oil prices after the Democrats swept the US midterm elections. Traders now await the US September payrolls report, expected to show 65,000 jobs added with unemployment steady at 4.2%, for clues on the Fed's rate path; markets price about a 71% chance of a December rate rise.

items.title: Why the silver price case now rests on investors
items.summary: Metals Focus, which compiles the World Silver Survey, now expects silver to swing to a 37.3-million-ounce surplus in 2027, from a 35.4-million-ounce deficit this year, as solar-panel makers use less silver per panel. It still sees a higher average price next year, but says the case rests on buying by silver funds, not a shortage, and silver should keep lagging gold near-term.

items.title: Ahead of Dhanteras, gold prices climb Rs 2,200 to Rs 1.48 lakh/10gm in Delhi
items.summary: Gold climbed Rs 2,200 to Rs 1.48 lakh per 10 g in Delhi ahead of Dhanteras, as festive buying picked up on the eve of the festival.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Turns Down Its Gold Targets After A Hawkish Fed
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 gold target to $4,150 an ounce from $4,650 and its end-2027 target to $4,800 from $5,400, saying a hawkish Federal Reserve and rates staying higher for longer make holding non-yielding gold less attractive. The bank still sees support from central-bank buying and long-term investors holding bullion as insurance against government debt and budget risks.

items.title: Neither the election nor the US Dollar: Why Friday's payrolls hold the key to Gold's next move
items.summary: Gold has climbed back above $4,000 as the dollar weakened after the US midterm elections, but traders still price roughly an 80% chance of a December Fed rate rise. Friday's US October payrolls report, with a consensus of 65,000 jobs, is the market's first chance to reprice Fed expectations and will show whether the rally is a lasting breakout or a temporary rebound.

items.title: Jewellers expect fall in gold prices to boost Dhantera sales
items.summary: Jewellers expect a busy Dhanteras as the recent fall in gold prices lifts demand, with advance bookings rising and coins, bars and lightweight hallmarked jewellery leading sales; the trade body estimates about 75 tonnes of sales, and one large jeweller reports enquiries up 40–50% since prices eased.

items.title: Indians Shift Gold Buying Trends This Dhanteras
items.summary: High prices are reshaping Dhanteras buying: shoppers are choosing lightweight jewellery, small coins and bars over heavy pieces, with a festive budget of Rs 30,000-50,000 buying lighter gold or more substantial silver pieces. Younger buyers are also turning to digital gold, while coins remain popular with those buying gold as an investment.

items.title: Gold vs silver this Dhanteras: Price outlook, buying trends and key risks
items.summary: CNBC-TV18 weighs gold against silver for Dhanteras buyers: gold is about 20% below its January peak and silver roughly 50% below, after silver's much sharper October correction. The piece notes silver's higher volatility and industrial demand, and that lower prices are drawing festive buyers toward lighter gold pieces and silver jewellery.

items.title: Fed's Hammack Repeats Call for Small Rate Increases to Curb Inflation
items.summary: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack repeated her call for smaller, more frequent rate increases to bring inflation back to 2%, saying policy still needs to tighten; she was one of two officials who dissented in favour of a hike when the Fed held rates last week, and markets price an 83% chance of a December increase, according to CME FedWatch.

items.title: Poland central bank chief leaves door open to more gold buying after hitting 700-ton target
items.summary: Poland's central bank has reached its 700-tonne gold reserve target and Governor Adam Glapinski said he sees no reason to stop buying, with holdings now worth 356 billion zlotys ($91.4 billion). Poland is the world's 10th-largest gold holder and the biggest reported central-bank buyer of 2024-2026, according to World Gold Council data.

items.title: Rupee hits over one-month high, 10-year bond yield falls to 7.17%
items.summary: The rupee closed at 94.47 against the dollar, its strongest since October 21, gaining for a fifth straight session as easing crude prices lifted sentiment, while the 10-year government bond yield fell to 7.17%, its lowest since September 29.

items.title: Reserve Bank of India may hike rates by up to 75 bps more: Uday Kotak
items.summary: Uday Kotak expects the RBI to raise the repo rate by another 50-75 basis points after its first increase this year, warning the tightening is weighing on long-term bonds, Business Standard reports. He cited prolonged West Asia risks and sharply higher oil, and noted India's deficit was only $26 billion in 2025-26 even after $72 billion of gold imports.

Silver is testing downtrend resistance from late-September highs after reclaiming $51.27 and $52.67, with gold's breakout from its own September downtrend lighting the way, FOREX.com's technical analysis says. The metals' 10-day correlation is +0.99 with silver's beta near 1.7, so a confirmed breakout could target $54.78-$58.50; $51.27-$52.67 must hold, with $48.86 the key support below.
items.title: Silver's bullish breakout case builds as bond yields retreat
Dhanteras Gold Buyers Turn To Informal Channels As Import Duty Fuels Smuggling
items.summary: A LocalCircles survey found 29% of planned Dhanteras gold buyers may use informal channels, as the 15% import duty plus GST lifts the total levy to about 18.45%. The World Gold Council put unofficial inflows at about 50 tonnes in July-September, up from about 3 tonnes a year earlier.

items.title: BIS Hallmarking System Strengthens Consumer Trust, Over 65 Crore Gold Articles Get HUID
items.summary: More than 65 crore gold articles have been hallmarked with a unique HUID since mandatory hallmarking began, the Bureau of Indian Standards said, as buyers check purity ahead of Dhanteras.

items.title: Gold Futures Rise To Rs 1.45 Lakh/10 Gm On Firm Spot Demand; Silver Futures Decline
items.summary: MCX December gold futures rose Rs 1,947 to Rs 1,45,181 per 10 g on firm spot demand, while December silver futures eased Rs 28 to Rs 1,87,707 per kg, PTI reports via ETV Bharat. Gold futures in New York rose 1.24% to $4,110.88 an ounce, while silver globally slipped 0.56% to $52.51.
